title: SB166 (2023 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2023/bills/SB166_.HTM; sha256 4e605b14e12f4197831777f5bb978832ff1cf58e2214aaf89eba83d047261ff0)
provenance.note: As-filed text. The quote leaves out words the bill strikes (the old wording limited the ban to magazines for a pistol). Same text as HI-SB-166-2024 (carry-over). No passage vote on file.

operative_text: SECTION 2 (HRS 134-8(c)): Except as provided in section 134-11, the manufacture, possession, sale, barter, trade, gift, transfer, or acquisition of detachable ammunition magazines with a capacity in excess of ten rounds that are designed for or capable of use with any firearm is prohibited.
